**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) — § 21.1**

The cap is mutual, but two defects breach the playbook:

1. **Basis far too low.** "Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event" is below even the walk-away floor of six months' fees, and is illusory against the USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment in § 2.1. The defined term "Fees" (§ 1.5) further excludes one-time implementation charges, shrinking the base.
2. **"Without exception" swallows the carve-outs.** § 21.3 already defines Excluded Claims in playbook-compliant terms (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), and § 21.2 has a mutual consequential-damages exclusion. But § 21.1's "without exception" pulls all of those inside a one-month cap, defeating § 21.3.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — single-sentence edit to § 21.1 only: cap set at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, with Excluded Claims expressly outside the cap. §§ 21.2–21.4 left intact since they already meet our position.
